messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.

On 1 March 2027 a non-professional user carries out a substantial modification to his or her own machine, for his or her own use. Under the act applicable on that day, is that user considered a manufacturer and subject to the manufacturer's obligations?

response.text: Il 1° marzo 2027 un utente non professionista apporta una modifica sostanziale alla propria macchina, per uso personale. Ai sensi della legge applicabile in quel giorno, tale utente è considerato un fabbricante e soggetto agli obblighi del fabbricante?
